pacerUsername.title: PACER username
pacerUsername.description: Your NextGen PACER login ID. Optional if MCP clients send the X-Pacer-Username header instead.

pacerPassword.title: PACER password
pacerPassword.description: Your PACER password. Optional if MCP clients send the X-Pacer-Password header instead.

pacerClientCode.title: PACER client code
pacerClientCode.description: Client code, only if your PACER account requires one.

pacerTotpSecret.title: PACER MFA (TOTP) secret
pacerTotpSecret.description: Base32 secret of your authenticator app enrollment, only if multi-factor authentication is enabled on the account. Used to generate a one-time code at each login.

redactFlag.title: Filer redaction attestation
redactFlag.description: Only for filer accounts: sends PACER's redactFlag, attesting that you comply with the redaction rules. Leave off for search-only accounts.

environment.title: PACER environment
environment.description: Use "qa" to test against PACER's QA environment (needs a separate QA account; searches there are not billed).
